name: G1 computeRegions: the type-7 tag line is asked with its end trimmed
why: a no-break space, form feed, vertical tab, byte order mark or U+2028 after the tag would be read as blank: `<a>` + NBSP then `# H` swallows the heading

name: G2 readChunkLabelToken: the first-slot class has no colon
G3 readChunkLabelToken: the first-slot class has no underscore
why: `{r fig-a_b}` and `{r tbl-x_y}` lose their labels

name: G4 readChunkLabelToken: the first-slot pattern has no start anchor
why: `knitrChunkHeaderLabel` accepts `{r fig-a$b}` (only the exported reader shows it; `indexLabels` validates the id again)

name: S4-01 endsHtmlBlock: the empty native div is asked with its end trimmed
why:
NO WITNESS: the mutant reads `
` + a no-break space (or form feed, vertical tab, byte order mark, U+2028) as an empty div, which the old pattern's `[ \t]*$` does not. 25,920 documents (five `from:` readers, eight lines above, nine below, eight blanks, three tails, three engine hints) show no difference in findHeadings or buildOutline, so the block end it moves is not visible to a heading; Session 335 found the witness of W01 by rendering, and so can a later session

name: S4-02 endsHtmlBlock: the empty native div is asked with its line trimmed
why: NO WITNESS, as S4-01: the leading blank is read by the pattern's own `[ \t]*` and every other leading blank fails the `<` test above the call

name: S4-03 endsHtmlBlock: the empty native div is asked in lower case
why: EQUIVALENT: the function folds the case of the tag name itself (the pattern had the `i` flag), and a lower-cased attribute block reads the same
